So, we work very closely with our foster care agencies to make sure that as they are recruiting foster parents, they’re following all of the state regulations as it pertains to certifications. We are aware of a very public case a few years back where there were concerns that while you know someone connected to the home involved in sex trafficking. We’ve talked as a response to that particular case.
